points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 顾恺之出生于江苏无锡一个士族家庭，自幼受到良好的文化熏陶。这一时期，他开始接触绘画艺术，展现出非凡的艺术天赋。家庭环境为他提供了丰富的文化资源和艺术氛围，使他有机会接触当时著名的文人雅士，为日后的艺术创作奠定了基础。他在家乡度过了童年和少年时期，这段经历对他的艺术风格和审美观念产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Gu Kaizhi was born into a noble family in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province, where he received excellent cultural education from an early age. During this period, he began to engage in painting and demonstrated extraordinary artistic talent. His family environment provided him with abundant cultural resources and artistic atmosphere, allowing him to meet famous literati and artists of the time, laying a solid foundation for his future artistic creations. He spent his childhood and adolescence in his hometown, an experience that profoundly influenced his artistic style and aesthetic concepts.

points.title: 仕途与艺术
points.description: 顾恺之进入建康，开始在东晋朝廷担任官职，历任散骑常侍、大司马参军等职。在政治上，他虽未担任要职，但凭借才华和学识受到朝廷重视。这一时期，他的艺术创作进入成熟阶段，创作了《女史箴图》、《洛神赋图》等重要作品。他在建康与当时的文人名士交往密切，形成了独特的艺术风格，奠定了中国绘画史上的重要地位。同时，他提出了'以形写神'的艺术理论，对中国绘画理论产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: Gu Kaizhi moved to Jiankang (modern Nanjing) and began serving in the Eastern Jin court, holding positions such as Sanqi Changshi and Da Sima Canjun. Although he did not hold important political positions, his talent and knowledge earned him respect from the imperial court. During this period, his artistic creation entered a mature stage, producing important works such as 'Nü Shi Zhen Tu' (Admonitions of the Instructress to the Court Ladies) and 'Luo Shen Fu Tu' (The Nymph of the Luo River). In Jiankang, he interacted closely with famous literati and scholars of the time, forming a unique artistic style and establishing an important position in Chinese art history. Meanwhile, he proposed the artistic theory of 'using form to express spirit' (yi xie xie shen), which had a profound impact on Chinese painting theory.

points.title: 隐居创作
points.description: 顾恺之因政治环境变化，选择隐居于会稽一带。这一时期，他远离政治中心，专注于艺术创作和理论研究。在会稽，他创作了《斫琴图》等重要作品，并进一步完善了自己的艺术理论。隐居生活使他能够更加深入地思考艺术本质，形成了独特的艺术风格。同时，他与当地文人雅士交往，交流艺术心得，扩大了自己的艺术视野。这段隐居经历对他的艺术创作产生了重要影响，使其作品更加注重意境和神韵的表达。
points.descriptionEn: Due to changes in the political environment, Gu Kaizhi chose to retreat in the Kuaiji area (modern Shaoxing). During this period, he distanced himself from the political center and focused on artistic creation and theoretical research. In Kuaiji, he created important works such as 'Zuo Qin Tu' (Portrait of a Zither Player) and further refined his artistic theories. The retired life allowed him to more deeply contemplate the essence of art, forming a unique artistic style. Meanwhile, he interacted with local literati and scholars, exchanging artistic insights and expanding his artistic horizons. This retreat experience had a significant impact on his artistic creation, making his works more focused on expressing artistic conception and spiritual charm.

points.title: 晚年回归
points.description: 顾恺之晚年重返建康，继续在朝廷任职，同时致力于艺术创作和教学。这一时期，他的艺术风格更加成熟，创作了《列女仁智图》等代表作。他在建康收徒授艺，培养了一批后起之秀，为中国绘画艺术的传承做出了重要贡献。同时，他进一步完善了自己的艺术理论，撰写了《论画》等重要著作，系统阐述了自己的艺术观点。晚年回归使他的艺术成就得到更广泛的认可，对中国绘画艺术的发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Gu Kaizhi returned to Jiankang (modern Nanjing), continued to serve in the imperial court, and devoted himself to artistic creation and teaching. During this period, his artistic style became more mature, and he created representative works such as 'Lie Nü Ren Zhi Tu' (Wise and Virtuous Women). He took on apprentices in Jiankang, cultivating a new generation of artists and making significant contributions to the inheritance of Chinese painting art. Meanwhile, he further refined his artistic theories and wrote important works such as 'Lun Hua' (On Painting), systematically expounding his artistic views. His return in later years led to wider recognition of his artistic achievements and had a profound impact on the development of Chinese painting art.

points.title: 晚年归乡
points.description: 顾恺之晚年回到家乡无锡，度过了生命的最后时光。在故乡，他继续进行艺术创作，整理自己的艺术理论和作品。这一时期，他的艺术风格更加圆融，作品更加注重意境和神韵的表达。在无锡，他与家乡文人雅士交往，传授艺术心得，培养了一批本地艺术人才。晚年归乡使他的艺术成就得到了家乡人民的认可，也为中国绘画艺术的传承和发展做出了最后的贡献。409年，顾恺之在无锡逝世，享年62岁，留下了丰富的艺术遗产和理论著作。
points.descriptionEn: In his final years, Gu Kaizhi returned to his hometown Wuxi, Jiangsu, spending the last moments of his life there. In his hometown, he continued to create art and organize his artistic theories and works. During this period, his artistic style became more harmonious, and his works paid more attention to expressing artistic conception and spiritual charm. In Wuxi, he interacted with local literati and scholars, transmitted his artistic insights, and cultivated a group of local artistic talents. Returning to his hometown in his later years earned him recognition from his fellow townspeople and made final contributions to the inheritance and development of Chinese painting art. In 409, Gu Kaizhi passed away in Wuxi at the age of 62, leaving behind a rich artistic heritage and theoretical works.

appraisal.zh: 顾恺之被公认为中国绘画史上的关键人物，其“以形写神”之说与《女史箴图》《洛神赋图》等经典深刻影响了后世千年，兼为杰出画家与重要理论家。不过也有研究者指出，其真迹多已失传，现存多为摹本，真实水平难以确评，且理论实践中或偏重形式而深度不足，政治作为亦有限。学界总体上仍视其为中国绘画艺术的重要奠基者，其遗产更多体现在理论贡献与对后世画家的深远影响上。
appraisal.en: Gu Kaizhi is widely recognized as a pivotal figure in Chinese painting history: his theory of expressing spirit through form and works such as Nü Shi Zhen Tu and Luo Shen Fu Tu shaped later centuries, and he stands as both an outstanding painter and an important theorist. Still, some researchers note that his originals are largely lost and surviving versions are later copies, making his true level hard to assess, while his theory may at times favor form over depth and his political role was limited. Scholarship nonetheless regards him as a founding figure whose legacy lies chiefly in his theoretical contributions and influence on later artists.

supporter.zh: 顾恺之被誉为中国绘画史上的'画圣'，是中国绘画艺术的奠基人之一。他提出的'以形写神'理论开创了中国绘画的新境界，强调通过外在形象表达内在精神，对中国绘画艺术产生了深远影响。他的作品《女史箴图》、《洛神赋图》等成为中国绘画史上的经典之作，影响后世千年。顾恺之不仅是一位杰出的画家，还是一位重要的艺术理论家，他的艺术成就和精神遗产为中国文化宝库增添了璀璨的一页。
supporter.en: Gu Kaizhi is revered as a 'saint of painting' in Chinese art history and one of the founders of Chinese painting art. His theory of 'using form to express spirit'开创ed a new realm in Chinese painting, emphasizing the expression of inner spirit through external forms, which had a profound impact on Chinese painting. His works such as 'Nü Shi Zhen Tu' and 'Luo Shen Fu Tu' have become classics in Chinese art history, influencing later generations for millennia. Gu Kaizhi was not only an outstanding painter but also an important art theorist, and his artistic achievements and spiritual heritage have added a brilliant page to China's cultural treasure.

critic.zh: 批评者认为顾恺之的艺术成就被过度神化，其作品多已失传，现存作品多为后世摹本，难以准确评估其真实艺术水平。此外，他的'以形写神'理论虽然强调精神表达，但在实践中可能过于注重形式而忽视内容，导致部分作品缺乏深度。同时，顾恺之在政治上的作为有限，未能将艺术才能转化为更大的社会影响力，这也被一些评论家视为其历史局限性的体现。
critic.en: Critics argue that Gu Kaizhi's artistic achievements have been overly mythologized, as most of his original works have been lost, and existing versions are mostly later copies, making it difficult to accurately assess his true artistic level. Furthermore, although his theory of 'using form to express spirit' emphasizes spiritual expression, in practice it may have focused too much on form while neglecting content, leading to some works lacking depth. Meanwhile, Gu Kaizhi's political achievements were limited, and he failed to transform his artistic talent into greater social influence, which some critics see as a manifestation of his historical limitations.

objective.zh: 从历史学和流行文化视角看，顾恺之被公认为中国绘画史上的重要人物，其艺术成就和历史地位得到广泛认可。在学术界，他被研究中国绘画艺术发展的关键人物，其艺术理论和创作实践对中国绘画产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，顾恺之的形象被广泛传播，成为中国文化艺术的象征之一。他的故事和作品被改编成各种艺术形式，影响着当代中国文化的传承和发展。顾恺之的艺术遗产不仅体现在他的作品上，更体现在他对中国绘画理论的贡献和对后世艺术家的影响上。
objective.en: From the perspective of historiography and popular culture, Gu Kaizhi is widely recognized as an important figure in Chinese art history, and his artistic achievements and historical position have been widely acknowledged. In academia, he is considered a key figure in the study of the development of Chinese painting art, and his artistic theories and creative practices have had a profound impact on Chinese painting. In popular culture, the image of Gu Kaizhi has been widely disseminated, becoming one of the symbols of Chinese culture and art. His stories and works have been adapted into various art forms, influencing the inheritance and development of contemporary Chinese culture. Gu Kaizhi's artistic legacy is not only reflected in his works but also in his contributions to Chinese painting theory and his influence on later artists.

self.en: Use form to express spirit, with both form and spirit complete.
